minutes.headline: Parks Commission let the youth baseball league place a storage container at Marshall Park and chose new officers.
minutes.summary: Commission heard facilities and recreation updates, then discussed turning the Marshall T-ball field into a dog park and a youth league request for a storage container at Marshall Park. Votes were taken on the container, and on a new chair, vice chair and clerk. Also covered: Beach house floor repair, a surplus equipment policy, Earth Day events and a revenue turnover policy.

what_happened.line: The Parks Commission voted to let the youth baseball league place a storage container at Marshall Park; the motion was withdrawn and restated, and the restated vote was not audible.
The Commission took its reorganization a month early and voted on a new chair, vice chair and clerk, though the outcomes were not audible on the recording.
Staff will move the no-dogs sign at the Marshall T-ball field and informally allow dogs there, with insurance, policy and formal dog park status to come back later.
A draft revenue turnover policy on handling cash receipts from programs, rentals and beach memberships is going to the select board; members were asked to send feedback to Heather.
Approval of the prior minutes was postponed, and the next meeting was set for May 15 at seven.

why_it_matters: The container decision and the T-ball field change affect how a town park is used and who carries the cost and insurance, with the league reported as paying for the container.
The revenue turnover policy would change how cash from programs, rentals and beach memberships is handled and turned over to the town.
watch_next: The Commission's next meeting on May 15 at seven, where the dog park insurance and policy item and the postponed minutes may return.
The select board's review of the draft revenue turnover policy.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the shape of the meeting: a storage container vote, the officer appointments and tabled minutes. Ours could not hear any vote outcomes, and the official minutes record all four votes as 5-0. The main difference to check is that the official minutes place the container at Powell Field with no dollar figure, while ours says Marshall Park with $3,500 and adds Marshall Park, picnic table and surplus policy figures the official minutes lack. The official minutes also list Ana Lockwood as present and include a Beach House item, neither of which is in ours.
